name: Yume no Saka
source:
Dream slope is a hill near student dormitory. According to old legend monsters used to appear from there. They were exterminated by a travelling samurai, but as he was leaving he predicted that evil would rise again on the slope.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/09/vn-of-month-september-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
梦之坡是学生宿舍附近的一座小山丘。根据古老的传说，那里曾经会出现怪物。它们被一个流浪的武士消灭了，但在离开时他预言邪恶将再次从坡上崛起。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/09/vn-of-month-september-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
